question: Your Node.js server uses renderToString. Which API do the docs recommend instead?
say: Your Node server uses render to string. Which API do the docs recommend instead?
explanation: On Node.js, use renderToPipeableStream: it can stream content as it loads. renderToStaticMarkup is for non-interactive HTML, and the other two are client APIs.
explainSay: Render to pipeable stream. On Node it streams content as it loads.
